theme: El mercado del pueblo — comprar y vender, los precios, la ropa, los colores y su concordancia, y señalar las cosas con este/esta
storyThread: Los mercaderes de Proverbios 31 (RV1909): la mujer hacendosa hace telas y las vende, y entrega cintas al mercader. L1 = el mercado y los precios; L2 = la ropa; L3 = los colores y la concordancia; L4 = este/esta: señalar lo que compramos.
grammarTargets: comprar/vender/costar in the present, finite forms only: compro, vende, cuesta (a1-u01 finite-form convention; a0-verbs' infinitive hacer stays the one exception). No compra (the noun) as an id — it would be a second id space
precio (noun) vs cuesta (verb): the unit's own noun/verb pair; the phrase «¿Cuánto cuesta?» lives in say/sign, the tile is cuesta (formIdRule)

colour agreement: the id is the masculine citation form (amarillo, rojo, negro) or the invariant (verde, azul, púrpura); the -a/-os/-as forms are NOT ids and are never option strings — the agreement switch is carried in the note and demonstrated in the say (a0-u06 descriptorDecision precedent)
demonstratives este/esta/esto/estos/estas + ese/esa: bare forms as tiles, the noun phrase in say/sign. este is a DUAL-SENSE re-pass (a0-u05 «east») — gloss widened at source per E1
cuestan deliberately EXCLUDED (plural price question) — the -n minimal-pair family, deferred with va/van and tiene/tienen (E8; joins A1-U8's deferred list)
present tense ONLY — pretérito is A1-U7. The scripture passage is past-tense and is exempt per the standing scripture ruling
waveNotes: l1 (11) = the market and the prices: 3 byte-identical re-passes (mercado a1-u03 — the D4 FORWARD-BIND IS DISCHARGED HERE as new:false/poolSource a1-u03, never re-introduced; tienda a0-u03; moneda a0-u03) + 8 new. mercado and mercader sit deliberately in ONE wave because the -der/-do contrast is the teaching point, but they never share an option set (near-form rule). l2 (10) = the clothes, all new: ropa/vestido/camisa/pantalón/falda/zapato/sombrero/cinturón/tela/abrigo. l3 (8) = the colours and the agreement: verde/blanco re-pass (a0-u03) + amarillo (closes an unbound spoken form — a0-u04 already says «Mira el maíz. Es amarillo.» with no id behind it, the F5 hole in reverse), rojo, azul, negro, púrpura, color. The invariant colours (verde, azul, púrpura) sit with the agreeing ones on purpose: one wave shows both behaviours. l4 (7) = the demonstratives: este re-pass (a0-u05, dual sense) + esta/esto/estos/estas/ese/esa new. The paradigm is in ONE wave (the a1-u02 tener- and a1-u03 ir-paradigm precedent) with the one-letter minimal pairs kept out of every hear-choose set. Largest wave = 11 — under the 12-per-page threshold (DEFECTS #18), no pagination. Wave 5 = adaptive replay from progress.misses (unchanged convention — matches a1-u01/a1-u02/a1-u03).

words.say: Prudencia vende ropa en el mercado.
words.caption: El mercado del pueblo
words.note: D4 FORWARD-BIND DISCHARGED: a1-u03 bound mercado with the explicit instruction that A1-U4 must RE-PASS it (new:false, poolSource a1-u03) and never re-introduce it. Byte-identical id, richer A1 sentence. mercado/mercader never share an option set.

words.caption: La tienda de ropa
words.note: re-pass (second A1 serve — spaced review of a1-u03). tienda (a shop) vs mercado (the market itself) is the unit's own place contrast.

words.caption: Una moneda de plata
words.note: re-pass; the coin you pay with. moneda (a coin) vs dinero (money in general) is the taught contrast, NOT a near pair — different sounds. The plural monedas appears in say/reading text only; the id stays singular (a0-u03 form).

words.say: El mercader trae tela de lejos.
words.caption: El mercader
words.note: SCRIPTURE TEACHES-WORD (Proverbios 31:24, VERIFIED — teachesForm mercader, occurs once). The unit's title word. mercader/mercado never share an option set: the -der/-do ending IS the listening discrimination.

words.say: Compro pan y queso en el mercado.
words.caption: Compro en el mercado
words.note: comprar 1st singular, present. compro/vende/cuesta is the unit's shop-verb contrast set (documented exception — the contrast IS the teaching point). compra (the noun, «la compra») is NOT an id — never an option string.

words.say: Prudencia vende tela en la tienda.
words.caption: Prudencia vende tela
words.note: vender 3rd singular, present. Prudencia = the market seller (proper noun in say only, never a tile). E5 RESOLVED: the verse reads «vendió» — vende does NOT occur as a token, so vende may serve as a decoy.

words.caption: El precio del pan
words.note: the price (noun). precio/cuesta is the noun/verb pair: the precio is a number, cuesta is what the thing does. precioso is not an id — never an option string.

words.caption: ¿Cuánto cuesta?
words.note: costar 3rd singular, present. The phrase «¿Cuánto cuesta?» lives in say/sign; the tile is cuesta (formIdRule, a0-u06 question-word precedent). cuánto alone is NOT a pool id (a1-u02 phantom-decoy ruling) and cuántos never shares a set with cuesta (cuán- cluster). cuestan deferred — E8.

words.caption: El abrigo es caro
words.note: caro/cara agree: el abrigo es caro, la camisa es cara. The -a form is NOT an id — never an option string. caro/barato sit together deliberately (the opposite pair is the teaching point); caro/claro is a listening note only (claro is not an id).

words.caption: La tela es barata
words.note: barato/barata agree. barato/barro NEVER share a set (barro is a0-u05 — extends a1-u03's barro/burro and barro/carro rule).

words.caption: Dinero para el pan
words.note: money in general (like ropa = clothes in general); moneda is one coin. dinero/moneda is the taught contrast, not a near pair.

words.caption: Ropa nueva
words.note: clothes as a mass (like dinero); tela is the cloth they are made of — the pair is the teaching point. rojo/ropa never share a set (ro- cluster). E5 re-check: ropa does NOT occur in the verse («telas» is the verse's word — a different token from the pool id tela).

words.caption: El vestido azul
words.note: the garment (a dress), not the participle of vestir. vestir is not an id — never an option string. One of the garments the Proverbios 31 household makes and wears.

words.caption: La camisa blanca
words.note: camisa/cama NEVER share a set (cam- cluster; cama is a0-u03). The say demonstrates feminine agreement with blanca.

words.caption: El pantalón azul
words.note: masculine despite the -ón ending; el pantalón, los pantalones. pantalón/falda is a taught garment contrast.

words.caption: La falda azul
words.note: falda (skirt) vs falta (fault, from faltar) is a real listening trap — falta is NOT a pool id, so it is never an option string (phantom-decoy rule); note only.

words.caption: Los zapatos nuevos
words.note: one zapato, two zapatos; the say shows the plural agreement nuevos. TPR prop for hear-act (artDebt).

words.caption: El sombrero grande
words.note: sombrero/sombra is a listening note only (sombra is not an id — never an option string). TPR prop for hear-act (artDebt).

words.caption: El cinturón negro
words.note: cinturón = belt. The Proverbios 31 merchant trades in cintas (ribbons/sashes) — cintas is a verse word, NOT an id, and cinturón/cintas never share a set. Also the natural word for the Armor belt (Ef 6:14 «ceñidos vuestros lomos de verdad»), a future armor-layer tie-in — no binding declared here.

words.caption: La tela roja
words.note: the merchant's goods — what the mercader brings and what the household weaves. tela (cloth) vs ropa (finished clothes) is the taught contrast. E5 note: the verse's token is «telas» (plural) — tela stays a legal decoy (exact-token rule), though it is not in the verse-complete options.

words.caption: Un abrigo nuevo
words.note: a warm coat. abrigar is not an id — never an option string. Carries the caro sentence («El abrigo es caro»).

words.caption: Verde como el campo
words.note: re-pass at A1 with agreement: verde does NOT change — la tela verde, el zapato verde. verde/verano never share a set (ver- cluster; verano a0-u06).

words.caption: Blanco como la nieve
words.note: re-pass; blanco/blanca agrees with the thing (el zapato blanco, la camisa blanca). blanca is NOT an id — never an option string (phantom-decoy rule).

words.caption: Amarillo como el sol
words.note: CLOSES AN UNBOUND SPOKEN FORM: a0-u04 already says «Mira el maíz. Es amarillo.» with no id behind amarillo (F5 hole in reverse, a1-u02's en precedent) — the say reuses that sentence's words. amarillo/amarilla agree; amarilla is NOT an id.

words.caption: Rojo como la tela
words.note: rojo/roja agree; roja is NOT an id. rojo/ropa never share a set (ro- cluster).

words.caption: Azul como el cielo
words.note: INVARIANT: el pantalón azul, la falda azul — one form, like verde and grande. The say uses the learner's own cielo (a0-u01).

words.caption: Negro como la noche
words.note: negro/negra agree: el sombrero negro, la falda negra. negra is NOT an id — never an option string.

words.caption: La tela púrpura
words.note: the royal/dyed cloth colour of Proverbios 31's household (and of the tabernacle curtains) — the story's own colour, invariant like verde and azul: la tela púrpura, el vestido púrpura. Included as a colour word in its own right; the scripture block does NOT depend on it. FUTURE: Proverbios 31:22 («de lino fino y púrpura es su vestido», fetched 21:3X) is the natural binding if a later unit wants púrpura/vestido as scripture words — recorded, not bound.

words.caption: ¿De qué color?
words.note: the noun that makes every colour question work; the pattern «¿De qué color es...?» lives in say/sign (formIdRule). color/calor NEVER share a set — a real listening trap (calor alone is not an id; hace calor is).

words.caption: Este vestido
words.note: DUAL SENSE — E1 RULED: a0-u05's gloss widened AT SOURCE to «this (m.); also east as a direction» (a0-packs.json:101). Here it is RE-SERVED as the demonstrative (new:false, poolSource a0-u05, never re-introduced as new). este/esta/esto/estos/estas never share a hear-choose set.

words.caption: Esta camisa
words.note: E2 CONFIRMED — THIRD ACCENT PAIR: esta (this, f.) vs está (is, a0-verbs) differ only by the accent (pool pairs: cómo/como, tu/tú, esta/está). Never in the same option set; tile-size accent distinctness is a Reviewer correctness check (DEFECTS #20 family, widened to three).

words.caption: ¿Qué es esto?
words.note: NEUTER: it points at a thing you have not named — «¿Qué es esto?» — and never takes a noun. esto/esta/estos never share a set (one-letter differences).

words.caption: Estos zapatos
words.note: estos + masculine plural noun: estos zapatos, estos sombreros. estos/estas never share a set (final -os/-as only).

words.caption: Estas telas rojas
words.note: estas + feminine plural noun: estas telas, estas camisas. estas/estos never share a set; estás (tú estás) is not a pool id — never an option string.

words.caption: Ese vestido
words.note: ese = that (near the person you speak to); este = this (near me). The distance contrast is the point; ese/este never share a set.

words.caption: Esa falda azul
words.note: esa + feminine noun: esa falda. esa/ese never share a set (final -a/-e only).

qna.charset: ASCII + á é í ó ú ñ ¿ ¡ in rendered fields; « » only in scripture.say (spoken-only). Proper nouns Prudencia (the seller) and any verse name appear in say text and are never tiles.
qna.nearFormRule: Never in the same hear-choose option set — INHERITED and still binding: cómo/como, vivo/vive, cree/crece/creó, por qué/porque, muro/pared, mi/mío, tu/tú, tiene/tienen, tienes/tiene, en/entre, nuevo/nuestro (a1-u02); va/van, ve/ven, ve/va, a/al, pueblo/puerta/puente, plaza/plato/planta, barro/burro, barro/carro, viaje/viejo, camello/camino, cruza/crece/cree, espera/escribe, cama/casa (a1-u03). NEW IN THIS PACK: mercader/mercado (both pool ids — the -der/-do ending is the whole discrimination); esta/está (THIRD accent pair — accent only); este/esta/esto/estos/estas (final vowel/-s only — the va/van family); estos/estas; ese/esa; ese/este; camisa/cama; barato/barro; color/calor (calor alone is not an id; hace calor is); verde/verano; rojo/ropa; cuesta/cuántos (cuán- cluster); cinturón/cintas (cintas is a verse word, not an id). DOCUMENTED EXCEPTIONS (deliberate, kept): (1) the taught contrast sets sit TOGETHER — caro/barato, dinero/moneda, ropa/tela, compro/vende/cuesta — because the contrast IS the teaching point (a0-verbs hay/está/tengo and a1-u03 derecha/izquierda precedent); (2) demonstrative paradigm members MAY share a WAVE but NEVER a hear-choose option set — the gender/number contrast is tested in gap-fill and reading, where the written noun resolves it (tiene/tienen precedent, C5); (3) a1-u02's mi/tu/su exception ids appear here only as DECOYS, never as targets; (4) a1-u02's hay/está/tengo, mi/tu/su, cuántos/cuándo exceptions remain documented; here mi/tu/su co-occur ONLY as decoys inside demonstrative sets — legal under exception (3) (possession paradigm as decoys, never as targets). NOT IDS, therefore NEVER option strings (phantom decoy, DEFECTS #14): blanca, roja, amarilla, negra, nuevas, monedas, cuánto, cuestan, falta, sombra, claro, calor, cintas, manto, precioso, vestir, compra (the noun).
qna.pagination: largest wave l1 = 11 ids, l2 = 10, l3 = 8, l4 = 7 — all under the 12-per-page threshold (DEFECTS #18). No split required. If the renderer's threshold is strictly-below-12, split l1 6+5.
qna.englishLevel: A1 — caption gloss optional, fades at immersion ≥1
qna.duplicateCheck: 30 new ids, 0 collisions against the 274-id taught pool (unit-01 52 es-ids (no te llamas — the "53 incl. te llamas" figure is void) + a0-packs 49 + a0-verbs 30 + a0-u02 45 + a0-u06 28 + a1-u01 22 + a1-u02 23 + a1-u03 25 = 274). 6 re-passes are byte-identical re-serves with new:false + poolSource (mercado a1-u03, tienda a0-u03, moneda a0-u03, verde a0-u03, blanco a0-u03, este a0-u05), never re-introduced as new. Pool after this pack = 304.
qna.optionsBoundToIds: Every option string is a bound pool id (274 existing + this pack's 30). Decoys are drawn from the same wave where possible (compro/vende/cuesta, camisa/vestido/falda) and from earlier A1 function/determiner ids for the demonstratives (mi a0-u01, su/tu a1-u02, qué/cuál a0-u06). No phantom decoys (DEFECTS #14).
qna.grammar: A1 register per THEOLOGY-guide §3.1 and the inherited A1 ruling: PRESENT TENSE ONLY — pretérito is A1-U7 (the scripture passage is exempt per the standing scripture ruling). No subjunctive, no negative commands, no vosotros. Every say is one idea and the target word is repeated in caption + sign. Agreement is taught by note + say, not by minting feminine ids.
qna.csa: Owner plain-truth directive applied: no sanitizing rules apply, and nothing is softened. The merchants of Proverbios 31 are honest traders — the unit's virtue is diligence and generosity (the passage's own point). No invented detail: the scripture block carries only the fetched verse. Money and trade are taught plainly without greed-framing or prosperity-framing either way. INT-1 holds — no doctrine-assent gate anywhere.
qna.formIdRule: ids are the exact form the learner hears and the string on the tile. Verbs are FINITE PRESENT forms (compro, vende, cuesta), not infinitives (a1-u01 convention; a0-verbs' hacer is the standing exception). Colours are masculine citation forms (amarillo, rojo, negro) or the invariant form (verde, azul, púrpura) — the -a/-os/-as agreement forms are NEVER ids (a0-u06 descriptorDecision). Demonstratives are the bare forms with the noun phrase in say/sign. Phrases («¿Cuánto cuesta?», «¿De qué color es...?») live in say/sign, the tile stays a word.
